questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true regarding the blood carried by the umbilical vein in fetal circulation, and how many umbilical veins are present?

options.label: A
options.text: The umbilical vein carries deoxygenated blood and there are two umbilical veins.

options.label: B
options.text: The umbilical vein carries oxygenated blood and there are two umbilical veins.

options.label: C
options.text: The umbilical vein carries oxygenated blood and there is one umbilical vein.

options.label: D
options.text: The umbilical vein carries deoxygenated blood and there is one umbilical vein.
